limits: Policy agreement is not approval of individual dataset labels or overlap decisions.
Pinned reducer may store an extracted confirmed update as provided; extraction and application state are distinct.
Filename-derived format is a requirement inference, not a verification of file bytes.
Earlier benchmark gold, parser policy and model scores remain unchanged.

ambiguous_cadence.rule: An unresolved cadence role supplies neither frequency nor prediction_frequency until clarified.

confirmation.rule: New explicit values and replacements are provided. An explicit affirmation of the same recorded value is confirmed; a replacement has correction_detected=true. Unchanged value and status without explicit confirmation give no update. An explicit format declaration may upgrade inferred to provided.

filename_format.rule: A clear supported filename extension supplies file_format with status inferred; an explicit format declaration is provided. Do not infer access mode, columns, contents, privacy or credentials from the name.
filename_format.unsupported_or_extensionless: No file_format inference. Query strings alone do not establish a file format.

multilingual_meaning.rule: English, Roman Urdu and mixed requests follow the same semantic rules; preserve the stated meaning and exact free-text values.

target_boundaries.rule: An explicitly described forecasting target supports problem_statement and target_description with the same exact meaningful target noun phrase; a column name alone does not imply its domain meaning.

unknown_information.rule: Unknown, undecided and unavailable information gives no slot update, invented default or indifference label.
